calls.title: EQT<>GrowthBook - Onboarding Discussion
calls.summary: GrowthBook's onboarding call addressed EQT's early-stage experimentation needs, with key pain points around limited traffic, long sales cycles, and the need for data-driven decision-making. Participants included Chris Sanders (GrowthBook onboarding lead), Jake Heier (GrowthBook), Simon Davidsson (EQT product owner), Karl Essunger (adra operational lead), and Jacob (adra UX lead). Next steps are to schedule a technical enablement call after June 3rd to set up SDKs
